notes.title: Hotfix - Version 1.2.7
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update is a minor hotfix that adresses 2 bugs:

- "Fashion Victim" achievement would not properly unlock after acquiring all outfits
- Progress of the final cup race would not properly reset during a game session

If you already own all the outfits in a savegame and not gotten the achievement so far, simply choose to end the current day ingame. The achievement will unlock at that time.

As always, have fun playing!

notes.title: Hotfix - Version 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is a quick hotfix adressing a single issue with multiplayer tournaments.
The following issue has been fixed:
- Starting a multiplayer tournament will not properly reset the tournament score

As always, have fun playing!

notes.title: Hotfix - Version 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is a hotfix adressing some bugs that have appeared after launch.

The following issues have been fixed:
- Starting a training session in the training hall could result in an infinate loading screen
- A training course in the meadow was not displayed correctly on the map

See you around, hope you all have a great holiday!
